name: @cc/dsh-delegation-brief
description: Renders delegation briefs from the project state register instead of prose: delegation_brief returns a deterministic text and briefHash (REQ and acceptance criteria verbatim, related decisions, mandatory tests with commands, non-scope, return format), and delegation_return validates a worker's structured return against the current criteria (brief_stale, return_unmapped). Root-only tools, static prompt section, no model-visible state of its own.
